verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents dedicated vertical endpoints, most clearly a Google News API with topic-token category filters (e.g. World, Business, Technology). It also documents separate Google Flights, Google Ads and Ads Transparency Center APIs, plus engines beyond Google (Bing, Baidu, eBay, Home Depot), so querying verticals through specific endpoints is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: no evidence of image or finance vertical endpoints, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of vertical coverage.
